While there are some signs of positive movement in liquidity (current assets, shareholders' equity), the concerning trends in operating expenses, increasing preferred dividends and, most critically, the discrepancy in the income statement, outweigh these. The apparent error in net income makes the overall financial health uncertain.  A deeper dive into the reconciliation of the income statement is urgently needed. The slight improvements in certain areas are insufficient to offset the significant concerns. Thus, the sentiment score is -0.5.
